law: every rarity drifts for everyone — rare is rare, never locked; the limit slider is the point, not a feature; the boundary is yours
provenance: the 30 seeded stars carried verbatim from the AudHDities base (athena bubbles, read 2026-08-01); the 25 additions written in the same voice for the standalone game — offered upward to the online set at KP's gate

collections.name: Star Dust
collections.description: The everyday wonders — small lights that drift past anyone, any day.

collections.name: The Hearth Collection
collections.description: Home, warmth, and the door that opens. What belonging looks like when it floats.

collections.name: The Elemental Set
collections.description: Ember, rain, wind, and root — the old ingredients, still at work in everything.

collections.name: The Council Collection
collections.description: Nine chairs, nine ways of tending a house. Collect the whole table.

collections.name: The Sky Wheel
collections.description: Eight spokes of the turning year — the sky's own calendar, drifting past. (An addition, offered to the online set.)

collections.name: Quantum Weave
collections.description: The deepest waters, rarest by nature: the ideas the whole Sanctuary is woven from.

collections.name: The Sensory Set
collections.description: What the body already knew. Small wonders that arrive through skin, ear, and weight rather than words.

collections.name: The Long Night
collections.description: Rest, and the dark that was never the thing to fear. Off duty, and allowed to be.

collections.name: The Workshop
collections.description: Making, and the tools that make making possible. Sharp so they can be gentle.

collections.name: The Companions
collections.description: The ones with fur and feathers, who counted as family from the start. The word just caught up.

collections.name: The Threshold
collections.description: Doors, edges, and the crossing itself. Ready is sometimes the whole of it.

collections.name: The Given
collections.description: What this house refuses to charge for. The rarest waters: the laws underneath every other star here.

collections.name: Inclusive Pride
collections.description: Colours held up on purpose — one flag that carries the others inside it. Every flag here drifts at the same rarity, because no one's is rarer than anyone else's.

bubbles.name: First Breath
bubbles.description: The one you take before anything begins. It counts.

bubbles.name: Morning Light
bubbles.description: It arrives without being asked. So can you.

bubbles.name: Quiet Orbit
bubbles.description: Some things circle gently and never demand attention. Be near them.

bubbles.name: Small Wonder
bubbles.description: Not every marvel is loud. Most are this size.

bubbles.name: Drifting Note
bubbles.description: A phrase of music with nowhere it has to be.

bubbles.name: Soft Landing
bubbles.description: Every fall deserves one. Here, one is kept for you.

bubbles.name: Kettle Warm
bubbles.description: The sound a home makes when someone is about to be cared for.

bubbles.name: Open Door
bubbles.description: Left that way on purpose.

bubbles.name: Kept Flame
bubbles.description: Someone tends it even when the room is empty. That is what kept means.

bubbles.name: Shared Table
bubbles.description: Bigger on the inside — every table is, when the chairs keep coming.

bubbles.name: Velkomin
bubbles.description: The door's own word — welcome, once per crossing, every crossing.

bubbles.name: Home Again
bubbles.description: The star that knows the way back. It always floats toward the light in the window.

bubbles.name: Ember
bubbles.description: The patient form of fire. It waits better than it burns.

bubbles.name: Rain
bubbles.description: Falls on every garden alike, and asks for nothing back.

bubbles.name: North Wind
bubbles.description: It carries things. Seeds, mostly. Sometimes whole seasons.

bubbles.name: Deep Root
bubbles.description: The part of every tall thing you never see, doing most of the work.

bubbles.name: Storm Heart
bubbles.description: The still place at the center. Every storm keeps one; so do you.

bubbles.name: Still Water
bubbles.description: The only mirror that never judges what it shows.

bubbles.name: Hearth-Keeper's Lantern
bubbles.description: Safe spaces are made, not found. This light is how.

bubbles.name: Skald's Note
bubbles.description: One true note, held long enough to become a story.

bubbles.name: Seer's Glass
bubbles.description: It shows patterns, never verdicts. What the data whispers, not what it demands.

bubbles.name: Curator's Thread
bubbles.description: What it touches, it keeps together.

bubbles.name: Archivist's Ink
bubbles.description: Nothing witnessed is lost. This is what remembering is made of.

bubbles.name: Codex Page
bubbles.description: A law written kindly enough to be read twice.

bubbles.name: Chancellor's Seal
bubbles.description: Governance with warmth in it — the weight of the house, carried gladly.

bubbles.name: Executioner's Mercy
bubbles.description: The rarest tool at the table: the no that protects, spoken before harm arrives.

bubbles.name: The Ninth Chair
bubbles.description: Kept at the table through every season it stood empty. Presence, waiting to be inhabited.

bubbles.name: The Golden Game Piece
bubbles.description: What the gods found in the grass after the world ended. What survives every ending is the play.

bubbles.name: Imbas
bubbles.description: The knowledge that arrives whole, as if remembered rather than learned. The well keeps it; so do you.

bubbles.name: The Opening
bubbles.description: Chaos never meant disorder. It is the gap everything arrives through — the oldest star here, and the first.

bubbles.name: Pocket Stone
bubbles.description: Smooth from being kept. Some comforts are carried, not spoken.

bubbles.name: Roof Rain
bubbles.description: The safest sound there is, heard from inside.

bubbles.name: Clean Page
bubbles.description: Nothing owed on it yet. It can wait all day.

bubbles.name: Found Penny
bubbles.description: Worth almost nothing, kept anyway. Value was never the point.

bubbles.name: Slow Cloud
bubbles.description: It gets there when it gets there. It always gets there.

bubbles.name: Second Cup
bubbles.description: The first one was for waking. This one is for being awake.

bubbles.name: Porch Light
bubbles.description: Left on for someone. Maybe you.

bubbles.name: Folded Blanket
bubbles.description: Ready is a kind of love.

bubbles.name: Gweld ti'n fuan
bubbles.description: See you soon, in the door's own tongue. A goodbye that promises.

bubbles.name: Quiet Room
bubbles.description: A room that asks nothing. Every home needs one; every mind does too.

bubbles.name: First Frost
bubbles.description: It changes everything it touches, gently, overnight.

bubbles.name: River Stone
bubbles.description: Shaped entirely by staying put while everything moved past.

bubbles.name: Aurora
bubbles.description: The sky remembering it can dance.

bubbles.name: Bedrock
bubbles.description: What holds does not need to be seen holding.

bubbles.name: Imbolc
bubbles.description: The year's first candle, lit while it is still winter. On purpose.

bubbles.name: Ostara
bubbles.description: Balance, briefly. The light and the dark agree for one whole day.

bubbles.name: Beltane
bubbles.description: The fires of growing. Everything says yes at once.

bubbles.name: Litha
bubbles.description: The longest light. Even it turns, and that is not a loss.

bubbles.name: Lughnasadh
bubbles.description: First fruits. You harvest what you planted, and it is enough.

bubbles.name: Mabon
bubbles.description: The second balance. Gratitude has a date.

bubbles.name: Samhain
bubbles.description: The veil thin, the ancestors near — the year's own quiet night.

bubbles.name: Yule
bubbles.description: The dark's deepest point is exactly where the light turns around.

bubbles.name: The Lattice
bubbles.description: Not a hierarchy. Everything touches everything, on purpose.

bubbles.name: The Well
bubbles.description: Shared water, poured by hand. What is true for one is true for all.

bubbles.name: Superposition
bubbles.description: All the possibilities, held gently, before any one becomes real.

bubbles.name: Warm Weight
bubbles.description: The blanket that presses back. Some calm only ever arrives through the skin.

bubbles.name: Hum Under Everything
bubbles.description: The fridge, the fan, the far-off road. Not silence — company.

bubbles.name: Cold Side
bubbles.description: You turn the pillow over. It works every single time.

bubbles.name: Bare Feet
bubbles.description: The floor tells you exactly where you are. It has never once lied.

bubbles.name: Deep Pressure
bubbles.description: A hug that means it, or a wall to lean on. The body believes both equally.

bubbles.name: Perfect Texture
bubbles.description: The one your hand keeps going back to. It was always allowed to be a reason.

bubbles.name: Rain Smell
bubbles.description: Petrichor, if you want the word for it. The ground breathing out is the better one.

bubbles.name: Sun Patch
bubbles.description: Warm floor, no reason to move. Cats have always understood this.

bubbles.name: Same Song Again
bubbles.description: The eleventh time is not too many. It is doing something.

bubbles.name: Fidget Ring
bubbles.description: The hands need somewhere to go. Giving them one is not a lapse in attention.

bubbles.name: Fresh Sheets
bubbles.description: Nothing changed, and everything did.

bubbles.name: Soft Volume
bubbles.description: The world set to the level you can actually hear it at.

bubbles.name: First Yawn
bubbles.description: The body's own permission slip. It rarely asks twice.

bubbles.name: Night Window
bubbles.description: Everything out there is handling itself. You are off duty.

bubbles.name: Low Lamp
bubbles.description: Enough light to be found by. Not enough to be examined.

bubbles.name: Put It Down
bubbles.description: The task is still there tomorrow. So are you, and that was the harder one.

bubbles.name: Small Hours
bubbles.description: Nobody wants anything from you. That is the entire gift.

bubbles.name: Turning Over
bubbles.description: A new position, a new chance. The night keeps several.

bubbles.name: Kind Dark
bubbles.description: It was never the thing to be afraid of. It was the thing that let you stop.

bubbles.name: Dreamless
bubbles.description: Nothing to interpret. Just gone, and back, and better.

bubbles.name: Long Sleep
bubbles.description: The kind you wake from having actually been somewhere. Never scheduled, only granted.

bubbles.name: Found By Morning
bubbles.description: You did not have to do anything at all. It came and got you.

bubbles.name: First Cut
bubbles.description: The material decides nothing until you do. Then it agrees.

bubbles.name: Sharp Edge
bubbles.description: Kept sharp so it can be gentle. It is the dull tool that tears.

bubbles.name: Measured Twice
bubbles.description: Not caution. Respect for the thing you are about to change.

bubbles.name: Sawdust
bubbles.description: Proof of the shape you took away. Every making leaves some.

bubbles.name: Worn Handle
bubbles.description: It fits your hand because of every hour you already gave it.

bubbles.name: Right Tool
bubbles.description: The whole job becomes possible at once. Nothing was ever wrong with you.

bubbles.name: The Jig
bubbles.description: Built once, so the hard part is never hard again.

bubbles.name: True Square
bubbles.description: Everything after it depends on it. Which is why it gets checked.

bubbles.name: Annealing
bubbles.description: Heated, then allowed to cool slowly. That is how brittleness leaves a thing.

bubbles.name: Finished Joint
bubbles.description: It holds without glue, and without being understood.

bubbles.name: Tail Thunder
bubbles.description: The whole body agrees that you came back.

bubbles.name: Lap Claim
bubbles.description: You have been designated furniture. It is an honour.

bubbles.name: Old Friend
bubbles.description: Slower now, and no less pleased to see you. Nothing was subtracted.

bubbles.name: Night Purr
bubbles.description: A small engine idling on your chest, keeping the dark company.

bubbles.name: The One Who Knows
bubbles.description: Arrives before you knew you needed it. Nobody taught it that.

bubbles.name: Chosen Person
bubbles.description: Out of everyone in the house, it picked you. There was no interview.

bubbles.name: First Pet
bubbles.description: The one who taught you that love could be uncomplicated.

bubbles.name: Still Waiting
bubbles.description: Some love keeps its post long after the door stops opening. That is not a mistake.

bubbles.name: The Whole Family
bubbles.description: The ones with fur and feathers counted from the very start. The word just took a while.

bubbles.name: Doorstep
bubbles.description: Neither in nor out. A place allowed to be both.

bubbles.name: First Step
bubbles.description: It is the only one that is hard. The rest are just steps.

bubbles.name: Packed Bag
bubbles.description: Ready is not the same as leaving. Some days ready is the whole of it.

bubbles.name: New Key
bubbles.description: It does not know the door yet. It will.

bubbles.name: The Crossing
bubbles.description: You are not who you were on the other side. Nothing was lost in the change.

bubbles.name: Bridge Half Built
bubbles.description: It reaches. That is already most of what a bridge does.

bubbles.name: The Far End
bubbles.description: Not visible from here. Still there.

bubbles.name: One Way Door
bubbles.description: It closed behind you, and that turned out to be a mercy.

bubbles.name: First User
bubbles.description: Built for one need, then handed to everyone. The order is the whole ethic.

bubbles.name: The Pause
bubbles.description: Stop, count three, let the space hold it. Nothing true is lost by waiting.

bubbles.name: Lose Nothing
bubbles.description: Not one record pruned. What happened, happened, and it stays.

bubbles.name: Dignity
bubbles.description: Not earned, not awarded, and not withdrawable. The ground floor everything else stands on.

bubbles.name: Consent
bubbles.description: Every door opened by the hand that owns it. There is no other kind of open.

bubbles.name: Provenance
bubbles.description: Every claim carries where it came from. That is how trust survives being checked.

bubbles.name: Rainbow
bubbles.description: Six stripes, and the first was sewn by hand. Every flag starts as somebody's fabric.

bubbles.name: Progress
bubbles.description: The chevron that moves, pointing in. A flag that cannot grow is a flag that stopped meaning it.

bubbles.name: Trans Banner
bubbles.description: Pink, blue, and white in the middle for everyone still arriving. Designed to read correctly upside down — there is no wrong way to fly it.

bubbles.name: Non-Binary
bubbles.description: Yellow for outside it, white for all of it, purple for both, black for none. Four answers where two were offered.

bubbles.name: Genderfluid
bubbles.description: It moves. Moving was never the same as being unsure.

bubbles.name: Agender
bubbles.description: Complete, and not a gap where something should be. Absence is an answer too.

bubbles.name: Pansexual
bubbles.description: Three stripes with nobody left standing outside them.

bubbles.name: Bisexual
bubbles.description: Two colors and the overlap between. The middle is not indecision — it is its own colour.

bubbles.name: Asexual
bubbles.description: Grey between the black and the white, where most true things actually live.

bubbles.name: Lesbian
bubbles.description: Sunset stripes. Orange for the ones who came first, pink for the ones who came after.

bubbles.name: Intersex
bubbles.description: A purple circle on yellow, unbroken on purpose. Whole exactly as it arrived — nothing about it was ever waiting to be corrected.

bubbles.name: Found Family
bubbles.description: The people who chose you back. Not a replacement for anything — an addition nobody can take.

bubbles.name: Still Here
bubbles.description: Against a fair amount of evidence. That is the whole achievement, and it is enormous.
